name: Nakamichi (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Nakamichi town emblem in orange: a winged ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal bars.
history: Flag of the former town of Nakamichi in Yamanashi Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-01. Flag and emblem were adopted on 14 September 1963.

features.role: Nakamichi town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal bars
